title: Kit A/B
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: Kit A/B, after the Analog Rytm mod: hold TRK and press NO to hear the active pattern's temp-saved kit (B, what FUNC+NO would bring back) while your edited kit (A) is kept aside; TRK+NO again brings your edits back. The temp copy is never overwritten, so FUNC+YES and FUNC+NO work as before. A small B shows in the top-right corner while B plays. Changing pattern while B plays puts your edits back into the pattern you left.
